evaluation: expanding-window rolling-origin; final chronological origin untouched until model/config freeze

warnings: Current USAspending snapshot: unavailable for historical point-in-time predictive claims.
Award Amount is a contract obligation, not delivery or recognized revenue.
Bulk exports do not reconstruct historical first-publication timestamps; available_at uses decision_date+14d and timestamp_quality=estimated.

constraints: Identical rows, algorithm and hyperparameters across ablations.
Current-snapshot procurement is excluded from historical gain claims.
Consolidated company revenue is not product- or segment-level device sales.

financial_marginal_value.interpretation: Positive PR-AUC/Precision@K and negative Brier/ECE are improvements; one holdout is not proof of a stable causal effect.

dataset.target: Any material public FDA 510(k)/original-or-panel-track PMA activity for an already-active company-track pair in the next 12 months
dataset.timing: Features require event_date<=cutoff and available_at<=cutoff; targets use future event_date; financial facts require filed<=cutoff

calibration.note: No recalibration is fitted before a sufficient verified sample exists.

procurement_descriptive.award_amount_meaning: contract obligation; not tender budget, delivery or recognized revenue
procurement_descriptive.coverage_warning: Recipient search and NAICS filters limit coverage; zero results do not establish zero demand.
